DT,

Thank you for your question, i hope you can now see part of what i did.

There is one difference in our charts and that is you draw your zones manually. Where as i have an indi that plots it, i have drawn more boxes than i can shake a stick at. And i watch many pairs on different tf's so i want quick upto date charts with no fussing around.

Let me tell you something i saw about a year ago that helped me out. You can watch new supply or demand being printed as price moves. My pink box is printed from a DBR, which then consumed the previous high and returned to demand. The only other place it could of gone is fresh supply!

All this happened while i was asleep and where was my TP, thats right you guessed it, just underneath new supply.

I hope this helps?

Warren

NERVES, i can only say that it comes from the nagging doubt in your mind that you cant do it. It is a self doubt.

Sure we all get butterflies in our stomach at times. A professional controls this, they see only the goal or task at hand and they are confident in their ability because they live have lived and breathed that moment in time for years.

I use to take Jared over the court at our sport centre and he used to put up 500 made shots, off the dribble, catch and free throws in between. His own rule was, if he looked down while doing a complex dribble before his shot he knocked out 5 push up as soon as the ball left his hands. And was ready to shoot again the moment i rebounded.

He was punishing himself, for looking down on complex moves, always pushing! It was painful to watch at first, but he made the adjustments and the drills become easier.

Take a free throw, it is the same shot everytime. You just need perfect form. If you repeat, repeat and repeat until you are sick of it, concentrate on the detail. Your body remembers every little motion in the move!

Its called muscle memory, this produces unconscious competence. These two phases are in every aspect of learning.....................Trading is no different.!

Warren wrote: Story of a mis-spent youth

23.00hrs on 19th November an alarm triggered on my mobile phone "Aud/Jpy Daily supply" After some analysis and a nice little engulf, i waited for a retrace for my entry.

Yawnnnnnn, off to bed i went. All set and done!

Nice to see this morning, price had moved away and fallen over night. Not bad, with a 3 or 4 pip drawdown, not quite IF style, but the right route for me.

Now i do not move my stop down, i let it run to TP, price can return to fill more orders and if your stop is now at breakeven then it's good bye!

Quite a bit of chop around this afternoon with News and such like but after seeing sneeky little engulfs lower, then finding supply above only to drop and make new lows.

I have looked at charts and thought i have no clue where this is going. Now, we all use patterns and thanks to the guys here they do look symmetrical and pretty. Sometimes it is hard to see were supply or demand is in the middle of a chop, but they are there.

IF wrote this somewhere........The patterns may not all be the same, but they all have the same rhyme

Hey Warren,

This is an excellent point!! You nailed it. The difference between the haves and the have nots is their depth of foresight. It takes someone with foresight to delay gratification for the bigger picture. The juxtaposition is that people who never reach their goals often have a basic inability to delay their gratification. Very few good things in this life come without assiduous effort and hard work towards that one common objective. When I first started my trading journey after college I realized that the amount of money one starts with is almost negligible and, in fact, having substantial capital with limited skill can be a detriment. It was about getting the process of consistent profitable trading down to a T and the profits will take care of themselves. We are all here for one reason, to leverage our time. True wealth doesn't come from addition (working a set hourly wage) but rather multiplication and we are here to MULTIPLY our money and leverage the time it takes to do so, therefore enjoying a freer and more efficient life. It truly warms my heart to be among so many like minded individuals that truly GET IT. Success can be a lonely road and its good to know that I'm not alone on it's path.

I love it!,

The life we except when we are younger is handed down generation to generation. We do not know any different so, it seems like the norm.

The typical life cycle;

From the moment we are born we strive to copy or assimilate our surroundings and as we grow older we get caught in the fighting for acceptance. The "done thing" comes into play, if everyone else is doing it, then its right? WRONG, run the other way! Look at the people you want to be like, be it successful, wealthy, happy, free. They live their life very different, not just the money and the trappings, but at a real basic level.

They do not buy stuff, they buy assets.

They do not watch Soaps and endless t.v, they educate themselves with books or researching, learning and understanding.

They do not post social media, talking about how they have just been shopping or what they are having for lunch. They use social media for business or linking with others that have a similar interest.

They spend time in the company of successful people. Not down the pub, with a bunch of no - hopers. ( You become the circles you move in )

They spend time with positive people, the doers and go getters in life. Not a couch potato, that hates his job, his wife and his lot in life!

Successful people plan every step and have goals set for everything. The herd only plan next years holiday

The have and the have nots are 2 different groups, the thing what separates them is what they do with their 24hrs. Regardless of age, sex, race, it is what you do with your time that counts.

It comes down to choice, screw what other people say, its your life...................change it!

Where does the time go, it has been pretty much a month since i have posted.

I must say, life has been full for a while now and i have had to prioritize my efforts, so not much posting.

A NEW YEAR MESSAGE FOR ALL.

This is the year YOU take control!

Is it the start of a New Year and a NEW you or will it be like all the other years full of empty promises.

You can not even blame others, because you made those promises to yourself. I bet they were the wishy washy kind, with no plan or goals. Just a “ I wish this year could be better” and by the end of January 2013 it was a distant memory.

Now I guess that you being here on this forum you have at least taken some action! But is it enough?

It starts and ends with this word CONTROL

You are either in control or you are controlled, that’s the brutal truth.

Every situation you have experienced and will experience in life is the outcome of someone being in control.

Be it, your Boss, Spouse, Family member, Friend, Bank manager, Creditor, Broker, Traffic Warden, Government official.

You see the truth of the matter is, if you do not plan or you stick your head in the sand regard to anything you need to address, someone else WILL take control of the situation! Eg: Your Boss controls you because you have placed yourself before him to serve under the contract you have signed. You are under his/her safety umbrella. They pay you, give you holiday entitlement, pay into a pension, a safe place to work

You have GIVEN them control over that aspect of your life.

Be it positive or negative.

The more you turn your back and let someone else deal with it, the less control you will feel in your life.

Successful people are aware of this life rule and set out to rid or minimize these controlling factors.

They understand that some forms of control can not be totally unchained, but managed into a happy medium. Other forms of control they rid themselves from. Think back to many different situations this past year, were you in control or just controlled and helpless to stop it?

Did the situation work out in your favour or the other party?

I will tell you, many a journey starts with the wanting of being successful…….mine did!

The more controlling influences there are in your life, the heavier the chains will be that keep you down. Until you can break those chains one at a time, success will be out of reach. For as you break each chain, you will feel lighter and lifted, a most empowering experience. The dreams you once had can start to be realised.

What will this year hold for you?

Will you be at 31st Dec 2014, with a heavy heart?

You may already be on the way or realising your dreams now, if so, why are you still reading this?

The truth has a habit of hitting a raw nerve, we can put a front on “yeah I am OK”

But deep down we know its not true, like a pain in the side that wont go away.

You know life doesn’t have to be this way, you can almost taste the good that is awaiting you…….its that close.

Whatever you want in life you need to fight for it, but not all fight is physical, some is mental. It is not about how many hours you work or how many trades you do in 24hrs.

It is work SMART, not HARD!

So if you make any kind of loose promise tonight, you may want to think who is waiting on the other side of 1st January 2014 to control your life. FROM tomorrow build it into your plan, what do you need to change in order for you to control more aspects of your life.

CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED CONTROL OR BE CONTROLLED

Whats it gonna be?

There is no nastiness involved in taking control, but someone has to do it.

Who’s life is it anyway?

See you on the other side.

Your Friend Warren
